notes.title: Patch - 0.94.0 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]0.94.0 Patch notes[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Seeker [/b]base damage buff
[*] Big [b]Asteroid[/b] value buff
[*] Added an alert when a [b]Planet [/b]is close by
[*] Changed [b]Bounty [/b]behavior
[*] Threat no longer scales with time, however it scales with [b]Bounty Score[/b]
[/list]

These changes are trying to shift the gameplay loop from rushing bounties as fast as possible and generally make the game feel less restricting. Game should feel easier and incentivize the player to explore.

tags.feature: [*] Added an alert when a Planet is close by

tags.balance_change: [*] Threat no longer scales with time, however it scales with Bounty Score
